calculation_handling.description: Amending instruction of By-law 1075-2026: removes "and" from the preceding item, re-punctuates the list and adds new regulation 10.5.40.40(3)(E) to Zoning By-law 569-2013.
calculation_handling.gaps: No zone is named in the instruction text, so application zones are left empty.

calculation_handling.description: New item 10.5.40.40(3)(E) (By-law 1075-2026): cladding added to the original exterior surface of a main wall, or to an addition or extension, including vents, pipes or utility equipment beneath the cladding, is added to the list in 10.5.40.40(3).
calculation_handling.gaps: The unit text carries only the list item, not the stem of 10.5.40.40(3), so the measurement it modifies is not stated here; keyed DEFINE (an inclusion/exclusion item in a measurement list) with target none, and no zone is named in the text. Whether cladding is added to an existing wall is an existing-building fact.

units.disclosure: Added exterior cladding on existing walls is treated under a special rule; this report does not account for it.
